description: This source file contains utility functions for testing React components using React Testing Library, specifically providing render wrappers with context providers and routers, as well as a comprehensive mock fetch framework for intercepting and sequencing network requests during testing.

methods.name: renderWithAppProvider
methods.description: Renders a React UI component wrapped only with AppProvider without any Router, useful for tests where routing context is unnecessary.

methods.name: renderWithRouterOnly
methods.description: Renders a React UI component wrapped with a Router (BrowserRouter or MemoryRouter), but without the AppProvider, suitable for components needing routing context.

methods.name: renderWithAppProviderAndRouter
methods.description: Wraps a React component with both AppProvider and a Router, useful when the component under test requires both contexts.

methods.name: deepEqual
methods.description: Internal function for deep comparison of primitives and plain objects, used for validating request payloads.

methods.name: createMockResponse
methods.description: Creates a mock Response-like object with specified data, status, and headers for testing fetch calls.

methods.name: mockFetchOnce
methods.description: Enqueues a single mock fetch response with optional status and headers, used for simple fetch mocking.

methods.name: mockFetchOnceError
methods.description: Enqueues a mock fetch response representing an error with a message and status.

methods.name: mockFetchQueue
methods.description: Enqueues a sequence of expected fetch calls with matchers, request validation, and response configurations, enabling complex fetch mocking scenarios.

methods.name: enqueueFetchMock({ match, response, responseFactory, description })
methods.description: Internal helper to add a mock fetch expectation to the queue.

methods.name: clearMockFetchQueue
methods.description: Clears all queued fetch expectations without warning.

methods.name: resetMockFetchQueue
methods.description: Resets the fetch mock expectations and queue, intended for use in test teardown.

methods.name: getMockFetchQueueSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a shallow copy of remaining fetch expectations for debugging or assertions.

methods.name: assertNoPendingFetchMocks
methods.description: Throws an error if there are any unconsumed fetch expectations remaining in the queue.
